original.subject: FW: Vendor Access Configuration — Per-Session Rules (F-1, F-3) — Final Approval
original.body:
Confirmed: Vendor access to TVC-JMP-01 is now restricted to individual accounts (F-3 closed) and per-session firewall rules (F-1 closed). The vendor VPN group remains disabled. All remote sessions require individual approval via the remote-access log (Annex A). No access has been granted since the security lockdown. Final verification completed at 12:27 PM.

— IT Operations Team
Teague Valley Chemical Company
